description:
Before the show, get into the mood.

A quiet countdown for your next concert, festival, or livehouse. Not a ticket wallet. Not an itinerary. Just a private space to slowly get closer to this one night.

Save your first 5 shows for free, then grow your free capacity by 1 show each calendar month. A Home Screen widget can keep the countdown in sight.

BeforeShow helps you:
• See the next show — the home screen holds one current show and its countdown
• Light reminders — only using facts you already saved
• Bring a show in — paste a link, scan a screenshot, or type it yourself
• Keep the night — a short rating, a note, and memory fragments that stay yours
• Festival timetable — every stage side by side, overlaps at a glance
• Pre-show listening — stage-by-stage mixes to warm up before doors open
• Lock Screen countdown — Live Activity and Dynamic Island show who's on stage
• Home Screen widgets — see how long is left without opening the app

How it works
1. Save your next concert, festival, or livehouse
2. Watch the countdown as the night gets closer
3. After the show, leave something behind and find it later in Footprints

The free plan starts with capacity for 5 saved shows, then can grow by 1 show each calendar month; deleting a show frees capacity. Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, and unlocks unlimited new shows. Prices are shown in the App Store at purchase.

promotionalText: New Listen search and unified artist photos. In Live Mode, the Live Activity now moves on to the next artist automatically. Now supports iOS 17.
whatsNew:
New Listen search and unified artist photos. In Live Mode, the Live Activity now moves on to the next artist automatically. Now supports iOS 17.

New
• Listen search: browse every disc in the current show's cabinet the moment you open it, or search by disc, artist, or song; connect artists not yet matched to Apple Music right from search
• Footprints search: find past shows with native search, and keep your query when you go back
• Single-artist shows lay every disc out on the shelf, no unfolding needed
• Unified artist photos: the same official Apple Music photo for an artist across Current, Timetable, Listen, Footprints, and Live Activities
• Automatic current show: switches by showtime, no manual setting when adding a show
• Timetable sets can now be edited across days
• iOS 17 support

Improved
• In Live Mode, the Live Activity switches to the next artist when their set starts instead of staying on the last one
• Live Activities for regular shows bring back the countdown and the "Live now" state
• Artist photos and artwork show more reliably in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen
• Live Mode remembers your chosen lead set and cover layout
• With several stages, the Timetable's Want button no longer gets pushed out of its card
• Fixed text fields needing two taps to bring up the keyboard
• Fixed Settings occasionally freezing on iOS 17
• Minor fixes and smoother interactions
